title: Formalize Conditional Displacement Tensor Operators
purpose: Define the mathematical operator layer for Memory Tensor RT after the core-action/displacement refinement, so future simulations and neuroscience mappings use the same formal structure.

S.name: Symmetric Condition
S.definition: The pre-distinction condition from which symmetry-breaking action becomes expressible.

delta_alpha.name: Symmetry-Breaking Action
delta_alpha.definition: Core-domain action by which <S> breaks into distinguishable orientation A.

triadic_comparison.name: Triadic Comparison
triadic_comparison.definition: Comparison of two symmetry-breaking actions sharing the same symmetric condition.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.definition: Local settlement of triadic tension into observable identity or memory output.

operator_definitions.description: Produces a distinguishable symmetry-breaking action from a symmetric condition.
Projects a core-domain symmetry-breaking action into tensor-domain displacement.
Compares two symmetry-breaking actions that share the same source condition.
Resolves triadic tension into an observable identity.
Generates memory and confidence from tensor traversal under coupling and optional implied memory.
Performs a procedural relational coupling between explicitly rebound affect-domain participants without treating observation as an object or measurement.

admissibility_rules.statement: A triadic comparison is admissible only when both operands reference a common symmetric condition <S>.
ΔX may be used in tensor calculations only when it is traceable to a corresponding δα(X|<S>) action trace.
Observable identity I must not be treated as prior to symmetry-breaking action.
Memory output M is an identity-like resolution within the memory domain, not a stored primitive object.

domain_separation.meta_domain_note: A and B are placeholders for the core effective pair only.
domain_separation.higher_domain_note: A and B may be rebound in higher domains only with explicit domain labeling and traceability.

forbidden_collapses: Do not treat meta-domain A/B as affect-domain participants without rebinding.
Do not detach δα(ℰ>0) from the non-null effective condition (ℰ≠0).
Do not treat RT as an object independent of the relational pair.

required_rebinding.rule: Affect-domain A/B shall only exist after explicit domain rebinding.

A_affect.definition: A distinguishable affect-domain participant, orientation, or basin after explicit rebinding.

B_affect.definition: A second distinguishable affect-domain participant, orientation, or basin after explicit rebinding.

relation.meaning: Domain-local coupling or comparison between explicitly rebound affect participants.

observation_relation.name: Primitive Observation
observation_relation.definition: Observation is a relational coupling event between explicitly rebound affect-domain participants.
properties: Observation does not modify the canonical meta-domain bindings.

governance_constraints: Do not reuse A_affect or B_affect as aliases of A_meta or B_meta.
Do not infer affect-domain coupling from meta-domain binding alone.
Do not alter the canonical RT expression.
